title: Chisato Moritaka: Watarase Bashi / Lala Sunshine
native_title: 森高千里 渡良瀬橋／ララ・サンシャイン
overview:
Includes lots of footage, including unreleased video clips of "Lala Sunshine," "Gin'iro no Yume," and "Let's Go!"

74 minutes of video clips in MPEG. High picture quality and high sound quality!

ララ サンシャイン、銀色の夢、Let's Go!の未発表ビデオクリップを含む映像を多数収録

74分のビデオクリップをMPEG化。高画質、高音質を実現！
